name: Exhicon Events Media Solutions
summary: Exhicon Events Media Solutions Ltd. provides a complete spectrum of offerings, from products to services, for the live events sector, encompassing exhibitions, conferences, and various gatherings. The company specializes in managing entire events on a turnkey basis, including the construction of trade fair infrastructure for both business-to-business (B2B) and business-to-consumer (B2C) events, accommodating projects of all sizes. Additionally, it extends its services and support to other domestic trade fair organizers. Established in 1997 by Mohammad Quaim Syed, Exhicon's operations are headquartered in Mumbai, India.
